name: auth
title: Sign-in and session
summary: Email sign-in, tokens in the OS secure store, single-flight refresh, protected route groups, sign-out that works offline, in-app account deletion, and a Saved list as the example of an account-only feature.
screens: | — | Sign in | `/sign-in` | launch when signed out | — | `POST /auth/login` | error | public |
| — | Saved | `/saved` | home header | `GET /me/saved` | open item; save → `POST /me/saved` | loading, empty, error | account |
| — | Delete account | sheet | account | — | `DELETE /auth/me` | busy, error | account |
dataInventory: | Email, password hash | sign-up / sign-in | backend database | — | account | until account deletion | yes |
| Saved items | Save | backend database | — | the Saved list | until removed or account deletion | yes |
claudeRules: Signed-in data reads the user from `useAuth()` (`src/modules/auth/session`); a screen that calls `useCurrentUser()` is wrapped in `withAccount`. Sign-out must work offline; only a refresh the server refuses ends a session.
